fields.summary_ko.0: Nvidia (NVDA) trades at a historically low valuation of 16x earnings, the cheapest in over 10 years, with last quarter free cash flow of $43.8 billion and expected revenue growth of approximately 100% this year.
fields.summary_ko.1: According to Apollo Global Management analysis, GPU supply shortages are appearing across the supply chain, with on-demand GPU capacity virtually sold out and rental rates rising even for prior-generation chips.
